content: Apple documents that moving capture processing to another queue makes the app responsible for bounded memory; alwaysDiscardsLateVideoFrames handles capture delivery only. AVPlayerLayer.videoRect expresses the displayed image rectangle. Camera authorization persists and must be checked before capture, with Settings recovery after denial. NSItemProvider temporary file representation expires when its completion handler returns. Project inference: bound app queue admission, compose model/source/display transforms, and track copied file ownership and load identity. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avcapturevideodataoutput/setsamplebufferdelegate(_:queue:) https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avplayerlayer/videorect https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/requesting-authorization-to-capture-and-save-media https://developer.apple.com/documentation/foundation/nsitemprovider/loadfilerepresentation(fortypeidentifier:completionhandler:)
